description: Player 1's deck for spec 08 at R389's 60-turn cap: 08-do-nothing-a with #100 Ceaseless Void swapped for #75 Infinite Reserves, a (0) Field Spell ("Drawing from an empty deck gives you a Rush Token card instead of fatigue."). Since patch v0.2.0 doubled the cap, two do-nothing 20-card decks fatigue out at player-turn 48 (R389's arithmetic, R2368000), so each seat now holds Infinite Reserves and plays it, the only card the spec plays. Everything else is 08-do-nothing-a's reasoning: no Cast-on-draw, no Quickdraw, no hand trigger, no X-cost or embiggen card, every other cost 3 or more, so nothing resolves by itself and no hero loses health. Nor is any card Tradable or Flashback, which would leave a turn something to do and keep R82 from ending it: #4665 made #26 Glowy Jelly Bean both, so #16 Hit Job, a 3-cost Spell with no Unit ever on the field to aim at, stands in its place, Infinite Reserves still last and so still dealt where the seed puts it. The spec's seed (08-turn-cap-26) deals Infinite Reserves into this seat's opening hand. Its seat plays under the handicap below, TUTORIAL_HUMAN's (R1705005): a human's resources with a deck of 20, the size every deck had before #1705, so these cards and the deal the spec's seed was tuned on stand. #5099: #25 4-mana 7/7, a card whose whole text is its keyword line, is dealt as a stand-in (crates/engine/src/testkit/stand_in.rs) spelling its numbers as it stood, in the same place in the list, so the deal is unchanged and no balance patch moves it.
